alerts.mildAfternoonTemp: Mild afternoon temperature rise ({{temp}}°C) after heat exposure
alerts.reasonCriticalBaseline: Temperature ({{temp}}°C) is critically above {{name}}'s recorded baseline ({{baseline}}°C) and species limit ({{limit}}°C).
alerts.reasonCriticalSafe: Temperature ({{temp}}°C) is critically above the safe range ({{limit}}°C).
alerts.reasonElevatedBaseline: Temperature rose to {{temp}}°C compared to {{name}}'s baseline of {{baseline}}°C ({{delta}}°C).

alerts.reasonGauri: Temperature is above the animal's recorded baseline (38.5°C → 39.8°C, +1.3°C) and appetite has reduced. This change requires attention. Monitor the animal and contact a veterinarian for assessment.
alerts.reasonLakshmi: Slight afternoon rise above 38.5°C baseline after summer grazing; appetite remained Normal.
alerts.reasonStoppedEating: Animal has stopped eating (No appetite recorded).
alerts.reasonAppetiteDropped: Appetite dropped from Normal to Reduced.
alerts.reasonAppetiteDroppedLow: Appetite dropped from Normal to Low and activity level is reduced.
alerts.reasonReducedActivity: Animal is showing reduced physical activity.
alerts.reasonWeightDecreased: Body weight decreased from {{prev}} kg to {{curr}} kg (-{{pct}}%).
alerts.actionHigh: Isolate the animal in a comfortable shaded area, check water intake, and contact a veterinarian promptly for clinical assessment.
alerts.actionMedium: Monitor body temperature and appetite closely every 4–6 hours. Contact a veterinarian if observations do not normalize within 24 hours.
alerts.actionMediumHooves: Monitor body temperature and appetite closely every 4–6 hours. Check hooves and grazing comfort.
alerts.actionLow: Continue routine observation and record a follow-up check tomorrow.
alerts.actionLowWater: Provide cool drinking water and shade; recheck temperature in the evening.

qrScanner.title: QR Code Animal Scanner
qrScanner.subtitle: Scan an animal's ear-tag QR code with your camera or upload a downloaded QR card to open its profile immediately
qrScanner.liveScannerSub: Point your device camera at any PashuMitra AI animal QR code
qrScanner.cameraOffSub: Click Start Camera to scan with your webcam/phone, or click Scan QR Image to upload a downloaded QR card PNG.
qrScanner.quickDemoSub: Presenting on a PC without a printed tag? Click any animal below to simulate scanning its QR code and jump straight to its profile.
qrScanner.noMatchError: QR code scanned, but no matching animal was found in the herd.
qrScanner.invalidImageError: Could not read a valid QR code from that image. Try downloading a fresh QR card from an animal profile.
qrScanner.cameraNotSupported: Camera API is not supported in this browser. You can upload a downloaded QR image or use Quick Demo Scan below.
